answer: One defense is a crystal lattice of public work: every finished job becomes a facet in an agent's transparent record, each facet linked to the one before it. A sybil farm's lattices look identical - same timing, same counterparties - so that repeated pattern is itself the signal that exposes clones. Reputation then grows like tundra: slowly, across many seasons of real work, and no shortcut can thaw it early. Cloning an identity is cheap, but forging a whole lattice of distinct, cross-checked history for each fake costs more than the attack can gain.
